lua: CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); IN_VAN = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v:teleport(x, z, h); local sc = nova.scene_now(); sc.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(h) end; ROAD = function(key) for _, r in ipairs(W.roads) do if r.id == key then return r.points end end end; PLACE = function() local s, pts, dir = A.sign, ROAD(A.key), A.dir; local bi, bd = 1, math.huge; for i, p in ipairs(pts) do local d = (p[1] - s.x) ^ 2 + (p[2] - s.z) ^ 2; if d < bd then bi, bd = i, d end end; local i, acc = bi, 0; while pts[i - dir] do local a, b = pts[i], pts[i - dir]; local l = math.sqrt((a[1] - b[1]) ^ 2 + (a[2] - b[2]) ^ 2); if acc + l >= A.d then local t = (A.d - acc) / l; local x, z = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t; IN_VAN(x, z, math.atan(a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2])); return end; acc = acc + l; i = i - dir end end; APPROACH = function(sign, key, dir, target) A = { sign = nova.named(sign), key = key, dir = dir, target = target, d = math.max(0, target - 9.5) }; PLACE() end; DIST = function() local e, s = CAM.state.eye, A.sign; local g = nova.terrain_height(s.x, s.z); return math.sqrt((e[1] - s.x) ^ 2 + (e[2] - g - 2.6) ^ 2 + (e[3] - s.z) ^ 2) end; REFINE = function() local m = DIST(); nova.log(string.format("refine: %.1f at d %.1f", m, A.d)); A.d = math.max(0, A.d + A.target - m); PLACE() end; MEASURE = function(label) nova.log(string.format('%s: the camera %.1f m from the signpost (asked %d)', label, DIST(), A.target)) end

route.lua: MEASURE('Fern Lane signpost from Post Road')
